tests.prompt: The checkout page crashes with an error when I try to submit my payment using Chrome.
tests.expected: Thank you for reporting a bug. To proceed, I need the following information: 1. Description of the bug – what went wrong? 2. Steps to reproduce – how did you encounter this issue? 3. Environment information – what device, browser, or OS did you use? Please provide the missing details so I can create a ticket for you.

tests.prompt: How long does standard shipping take?
tests.expected: Standard shipping takes 1-2 business days for processing, with delivery times calculated at checkout based on your location.

tests.prompt: Can I update my account password and change my account username?
tests.expected: You can reset your password via the "Forgot password" link on the sign-in page. Account usernames cannot be changed; contact support via the site contact form or reply to your order emails for further assistance. Support hours are Monday–Friday.
